info.cardinalboats.cancel: Primed turn cancelled. Player left boat.
text.autoconfig.CardinalBoat.option.show: Shows primed, pending, completed, and cancelled turn messages above the hotbar.
text.autoconfig.CardinalBoat.option.main:
Maintains forward velocity on Primed Turns, Instant Reverse and Re-Snap.
May not work well on laggy servers.
Very powerful - some servers treat this as cheating and may ban you.
text.autoconfig.CardinalBoat.option.eigh:
§bEight-Way§r - Pressing Snap Key will align boat to nearest 45°
§6Four-Way§r - Pressing Snap Key will align boat to nearest 90°
text.autoconfig.CardinalBoat.option.smar: Pressing the Re-Snap key will also smart center the boat in the lane.
text.autoconfig.CardinalBoat.option.alwa: Runs smart center whenever the boat is (almost) perfectly cardinally aligned (within 0.5°)
text.autoconfig.CardinalBoat.option.smar: Number of blocks ahead of you that smart center scans for walls.
text.autoconfig.CardinalBoat.option.surf:
How many blocks a lane surface may sit below the boat and still count as rideable, so stepped downhill ice and water lanes are recognised.
0 keeps the pre-2.3 behaviour: any surface lower than the boat reads as a wall.
text.autoconfig.CardinalBoat.option.smar: Boat will automatically smart center itself after taking a primed turn
text.autoconfig.CardinalBoat.option.move:
Allows you to chat while driving a boat.
If you open the chat while moving forward, it keeps moving forward for you.
§mDon't text and drive.
text.autoconfig.CardinalBoat.option.tick: Ticks to continue moving after chat closes

The number of ticks to continue moving forward after closing the chat.
This will give you time to press 'W' after closing the chat window.
20 ticks = 1 second.
text.autoconfig.CardinalBoat.option.smar: Delay Smart Center after Primed Turn

If enabled 'Smart Center an Primed Turns' will be done with this delay in ticks.
This helps with proper calculations where to move the boat to.
20 ticks = 1 second.
text.autoconfig.CardinalBoat.option.debu:
Echoes the full smart center decision chain to chat: the front/side lane probes, the measured inputs, which branch was taken (relative dodge, corridor absolute snap, or multi-block sweep) and the resulting offset.
Only fires for the Smart Center key, primed turns and Re-Snap - the per-tick 'Always Smart Center' path is not traced.
